metrics.counting: Only unique full-analysis product paragraphs count toward body gates; summaries, captions, coverage and sources excluded.

topics.zhHeadline: Zush把文件归档到多层目录，先列出改名与移动方案
topics.enHeadline: Zush follows nested filing rules and previews names and destinations
topics.evidence: Vendor-documented release and interaction; no independent product trial
topics.eventDateNote: day; exact clock and timezone not disclosed
topics.delta_since_last_seen: The October 31 Mac 3.22 update improves nested folder rules, preserves specified folder names and waits for images to finish saving before renaming.

topics.zhHeadline: Ideogram限定局部编辑窗口，让大图不用整张缩小
topics.enHeadline: Ideogram confines edits to a window without shrinking the whole image
topics.evidence: Vendor documentation and dated PH presentation; no independent image-editing test
topics.eventDateNote: PH appearance date only; upgrade first-availability time and timezone unverified
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Recoloring, object removal and label repair can avoid a separate crop-and-paste workflow. The vendor says pixels outside the window remain unchanged.

topics.zhHeadline: AirJelly能接着看屏幕回答，插话可排队或立即改变方向
topics.enHeadline: AirJelly adds requested screen context and a choice to queue or interrupt
topics.evidence: Vendor-documented release and interaction; no independent product trial
topics.eventDateNote: day; October30 exact time unknown, lower72h boundary uncertain, classified seven-day conservatively; November2 v2.0.17 first observed after cutoff and excluded
topics.delta_since_last_seen: This removes some screenshot, paste and waiting steps, while making the difference between a draft and an immediate request important.

topics.zhHeadline: TapCraft让遮罩跟着滚动文字移动，发布前仍需检查漏掉的画面
topics.enHeadline: TapCraft follows scrolling text with masks, while final footage still needs review
topics.evidence: Vendor release/help documentation; no export or redaction test
topics.eventDateNote: day; exact clock/timezone unknown; lower72h boundary uncertain, seven-day conservatively
topics.delta_since_last_seen: This avoids drawing repeated masks for one scrolling email, but model details and missed-detection rates were not disclosed.

topics.zhHeadline: Usage把Claude与Codex余量放在一起，提醒规则可先看再保存
topics.enHeadline: Usage puts Claude and Codex limits together with reviewable alert rules
topics.evidence: Maker documentation, developer App Store listing and PH launch; no independent account test
topics.eventDateNote: day; maker blog index October29, App Store relative3d not used as exact date; November1PH separate appearance
topics.delta_since_last_seen: It reduces trips to separate settings pages. It does not increase an allowance or guarantee that the next task will avoid a limit.

topics.zhHeadline: HomePod mini 2想兼任Mac音箱，连接兑现与Siri AI交付要分开看
topics.enHeadline: HomePod mini 2 targets the Mac desk while Siri AI remains a later update
topics.evidence: Independent two-day review and original Apple feature/availability documentation; no editorial device test; single-setup failure not universal incidence
topics.eventDateNote: minute; original rendered date SundayNovember1 09:00UTC-05:00
topics.delta_since_last_seen: A November 1 hands-on found faster basic Siri responses but could not make persistent Mac AirPlay work on the reviewer’s setup; this is one configuration.

topics.zhHeadline: Ring PRO把佩戴数据接到Jade问答，尺寸和可用额度先要弄清
topics.enHeadline: Ring PRO connects worn data to Jade questions, with fit and usage limits to check
topics.evidence: Retailer-hosted month-long reviewer experience plus manufacturer specifications and current US commercial terms; no editorial wear test or clinical validation
topics.eventDateNote: day; reviewer publication clock unknown; conservatively seven-day because October30 overlaps lower72h boundary
topics.delta_since_last_seen: An October 30 wear review adds fit and interface experience. The product already existed, so this is a review follow-up.

topics.zhHeadline: Muse开发板能改对话入口，口袋助手的可读性要自己补齐
topics.enHeadline: A Muse development board lets owners change how a pocket assistant answers
topics.evidence: Author-made device and personal report plus official SDK/boarddocumentation; no independent codeaudit or retailCharm test
topics.eventDateNote: minute; original source explicitly October31 4:05PM UTC
topics.delta_since_last_seen: An October 31 DIY report adds evidence of custom conversation-history and spoken-output features; it is not the retail Muse Charm launch.

topics.zhHeadline: ProArt P16跑本地资料提取，任务包的范围比漂亮表格更重要
topics.enHeadline: ProArt P16 runs local extraction, but a tidy table still needs a bounded task
topics.evidence: Independent single-laptop workload report, official hardware and model documentation; no editorial execution or replication
topics.eventDateNote: day; review publication clock unknown; tests performed October28; conservatively near-three-day, not proven inside main24h
topics.delta_since_last_seen: This is a workload-review follow-up for an existing laptop: tests occurred October 28 and the article appeared November 1, rather than a new hardware release.

topics.zhHeadline: Riverside从已经剪好的版本抽短片，删掉的内容不用再删一次
topics.enHeadline: Riverside makes short clips from the edit you already approved
topics.evidence: Original maintainer release and documentation; no independent execution or outcome test
topics.eventDateNote: Official day-only October28 update, clock/timezone unknown; firmly within seven-day supplement
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Existing cuts carry into the source for clipping, reducing rework when a raw-recording clip would revive a passage already removed.

topics.zhHeadline: 拾趣把选中文字填进日历，日期范围和原文链接一起带过去
topics.enHeadline: Magpie turns selected text into a calendar draft with dates and source links
topics.evidence: Original MIT repository, version-pinned documentation and timestamped GitHub releases; not hands-on tested
topics.eventDateNote: Exact GitHub release published_at; November 1 v0.1.19 is a separate hover-highlight fix
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Built-in recognition is the fallback. Extraction can be disabled and its prompt edited. November 1 only repairs button highlighting.

topics.zhHeadline: Agent Zero把读写权限拆开，配置审查能看到具体动作
topics.enHeadline: Agent Zero separates read and write permissions into reviewable actions
topics.evidence: Original maintainer release and documentation; no independent execution or outcome test
topics.eventDateNote: Exact UTC from original GitHub release API
topics.delta_since_last_seen: On, Default and Off distinguish explicit overrides from inheritance. Users review actual configuration changes before Save; Save & Test opens a fresh conversation.

topics.zhHeadline: Codex补上终端历史选择和队列恢复，少丢一次中断前的工作
topics.enHeadline: Codex adds transcript selection and queued-thread recovery
topics.evidence: Original maintainer release and documentation; no independent execution or outcome test
topics.eventDateNote: Exact UTC from original GitHub release API
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Queue --resume can revive an unloaded thread after adding a message, while doctor --network-only focuses on connection diagnostics. Unarchiving a parent also restores descendants. Before retrying interrupted work, developers still need to inspect the actual files and execution state.

topics.zhHeadline: Playwright MCP让多账号分开保存会话，找元素时少塞无关结果
topics.enHeadline: Playwright MCP separates account sessions and bounds element-search results
topics.evidence: Original maintainer release and documentation; no independent execution or outcome test
topics.eventDateNote: Exact UTC from original GitHub release API
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Element finding can limit returned matches while reporting the total; network inspection can retain a bounded history across navigations.

topics.zhHeadline: fx把模型调用留在宿主，沙箱只负责文件和命令
topics.enHeadline: fx keeps model calls on the host and file operations in the sandbox
topics.evidence: Original maintainer release and documentation; no independent execution or outcome test
topics.eventDateNote: Official day-only October29, clock/timezone unknown; within seven-day supplement
topics.delta_since_last_seen: It removes the need to install fx, run a bridge or expose a connection port inside the sandbox; model credentials stay on the host.

topics.zhHeadline: Nesformer把NES处理器写进模型权重，按键脚本慢慢生成游戏画面
topics.enHeadline: Nesformer runs scripted NES games through compiled model weights
topics.evidence: Original MIT repository and maker explanation; execution and performance not independently tested here
topics.eventDateNote: Public observation day from original link-blog; 21:59 shown without timezone; first-release clock not confirmed
topics.delta_since_last_seen: It does not train a model to guess game pictures. The same weights load different NROM games and support stepwise reference comparisons. The output is a traceable instruction sequence, not an agent learning to win.

topics.zhHeadline: Inkitiate把手写问题和圈选材料一起交给代理，结果留在原画布
topics.enHeadline: Inkitiate sends handwriting and selected materials to an agent, keeping results on the canvas
topics.evidence: Author paper and research figures; no independent product trial.
topics.eventDateNote: Exact arXiv submission October29; October30 dated listing; public announcement clock unconfirmed. Conservative seven-day backfill.
topics.delta_since_last_seen: A nearby task card exposes the interpreted request, activity and Stop control, reducing the need to reconstruct context in a separate chat.

topics.zhHeadline: LogicTree让AI改论点树，接受修改后再写进结构
topics.enHeadline: LogicTree makes AI revisions inspectable inside an argument tree
topics.evidence: Original authors' controlled study and prototype figure, not independent hands-on use.
topics.eventDateNote: Exact submission timestamp; public announcement clock unconfirmed; seven-day backfill, not main-window launch
topics.delta_since_last_seen: This gives revisions a stable target, reducing repeated explanations of which passage to change. Arbitrary prose edits do not automatically synchronize back into the tree.

topics.zhHeadline: StreamStudio从视频中途分叉续拍，保留已经满意的开头
topics.enHeadline: StreamStudio branches a video continuation while keeping the accepted opening
topics.evidence: Authors' system description and genuine interface figure; no user-study or independent speed measurements reported.
topics.eventDateNote: Exact arXiv submission, not public announcement clock; seven-day research backfill
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Stored inference state supports branching from existing context, reducing the need to regenerate an accepted opening.

topics.zhHeadline: TouchBridge记录指尖接触位置，让人的演示更适合机器人学
topics.enHeadline: TouchBridge records fingertip contact to make human demonstrations usable by robots
topics.evidence: Authors' four-task real-robot evaluation and hardware figures; not independent replication.
topics.eventDateNote: Exact arXiv submission; public announcement clock unconfirmed. Conservative seven-day research backfill. Original dated Robotics list confirms October30 public listing; exact clock unconfirmed.
topics.delta_since_last_seen: The transfer aligns contact patches and relationships between fingers, rather than matching pose alone. Conversion does not require an object mesh or physical simulation.

topics.zhHeadline: SwapBot给厨房工具加触觉适配器，机器人自己换刀、刷子和夹子
topics.enHeadline: SwapBot adds tactile adapters so a robot can exchange knives, brushes and tongs
topics.evidence: Original hardware design and author laboratory evaluations, no independent replication.
topics.eventDateNote: Exact arXiv submission timestamp; public announcement clock unconfirmed; seven-day research backfill Original dated Robotics list confirms October30 public listing; exact clock unconfirmed.
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Electromagnetic coupling enables exchange, while piezoresistive sensing adds contact information. Thin tools may sense only at the handle, rather than directly at the tip.

topics.zhHeadline: SenseNova-Loop复用同一组层处理图文，部署要匹配循环执行顺序
topics.enHeadline: SenseNova-Loop reuses decoder layers for image-and-text tasks
topics.evidence: Original repository and model card; model architecture diagram inspected, no editor benchmark or deployment
topics.eventDateNote: Original README release day only; exact launch time and timezone unconfirmed
topics.delta_since_last_seen: The October 30 release includes inference and serving instructions under Apache 2.0; its exact launch clock is unverified.

eventCounts.interpretation: Announcements, submissions, updates and regional reports; not first product launches.
